title: 第3章 练气四重第4章 选择武技或术法
content_zh:
“嗯，我明白的，放心好了，父亲，母亲，我一定会在家族检验前修炼到练气四重的。“
叶非凡坚定的做出保证，他在叶家呆了一年，对于聚气丹的功效也有所听闻，能够在练气前中期加快聚气速度，毕竟练气镜前中期没有什么特别的难点，主要就是将灵气存储在体内，存储的越多，境界就越高。聚气丹可以一定程度上加快吸收灵气这一过程，可以说是现阶段非常适合叶非凡的一种丹药。
所谓没有最好的丹药，只有适合的丹药。当然，如果此时能有那种改变灵根逆天改命的丹药就更好了，可惜只能想想，那种丹药只要你叶家敢有，别人就敢让你灰飞烟灭，毕竟筑基后期在这个世界中还真是不够看，属于底层人士。
“拿去吧，这盒子里就是10颗聚气丹，这段时间也别到处跑了，先老老实实的把这丹药服用了吧。“叶虎拿出一个木盒递给叶非凡。
叶非凡接过盒子，打开盒子后，只见里面整整齐齐的放着10颗聚气丹，脑中不自觉的浮现出一股想法。
“这就是聚气丹？怎么越看越像麦丽素，看这外形，看这颜色，看这光泽，啧啧，不知道炼制的时候有没有放糖，希望不会太苦吧。“
“父亲，我哥和我姐他们现在什么境界了？“叶非凡暂停胡思乱想，问道。
“你大哥叶飞扬现在已经是练气十一重，又是家主的儿子，老祖对其很看重，目前当作未来家主在培养，将来有很大希望继承家主的位置。
你二哥叶兴怀，现在练气九重，虽然比不上叶飞扬，但在年轻一辈中已经算是很不错的表现了，将来估计能得一个长老的位置，前提是能够顺利突破到筑基期。
你三姐叶凝霜，练气八重，目前放在年轻一辈中相比，只能说是中规中矩，后续有什么安排还不得而知。
至于其他的年轻一辈，从练气三重到练气九重的都有，你在其中是属于垫底的存在。虽然大家都知道你因为脑袋受伤昏迷了多年，但毕竟身为叶家的嫡子之一，这个修为难保不会有人说些闲话，希望非凡你能保持好心态，不要受到其他人的影响。“
叶虎一一说着其他人的情况，顺便向叶非凡做一些预警，毕竟叶非凡也是年轻人，深怕他受到一些影响做出不理智的事情来。
但叶虎万万没想到，这个叶非凡已经不是从前的叶非凡，新的叶非凡深受前世网络小说的影响，与其说是害怕被人嘲讽，他现在更期待能够受到嘲讽，这样就有希望开挂了，嘲讽嘛，来就是了，等以后开挂了再打脸回来，讲的就是一个礼尚往来。
“那这次家族检验主要内容是只检测修为吗？会不会有同辈比武切磋之类的？“
叶非凡看着父亲问道
“家族检验主要就是集中检查下同辈的修为，也好让大家相互之间有个了解，同时也希望更能给在前列的年轻一辈一些压力，给落后的年轻一辈一些动力，至于比武切磋的话，这个应该会有，但你不用担心，你因为境界还比较低，也没有学到什么武技或者术法，就算是有，肯定也不会安排你上场比武切磋的。“叶虎担心叶非凡因为境界低微，害怕切磋比武，因此安慰他说到。
“好的，父亲，我知道了，那我就先回去修炼了。”
得到想要的情报后，收起装有聚气丹的盒子，叶非凡就此向叶虎告辞。
“嗯，那你去吧，我和你母亲还要处理商铺中的一些事情，你也别到处跑了，看你之前每天白天都集市里到处转，也不知道在干什么，如果这么有时间，还不如来我这里学习学习，这样后续也能更好的接手这个商铺管事的位置。“
“好好，我明白的，那我走了。“叶非凡有些敷衍的回答后就走出了房间。

看着儿子离去的身影，孙素素叹了一口气。
”儿子醒来后，就感觉和我们没有以前那么亲近了。”
“是你多心了吧，非凡他毕竟昏迷了几年，现在醒来后，多少也算是个大人了，肯定不会像以前那样亲近我们，再说了，我偷偷观察了一段时间，以他的修炼情况来说，不像是有大能夺舍的样子。”叶虎看着妻子说道。
孙素素也点点头并感叹道。
“非凡他错失了好几年，希望不要影响到他以后的生活就好。”
……
叶非凡离开叶家商铺后却并没有直接回去，而是继续在集市中转着。
这也是他的日常之一，有空就来集市这边逛逛，兴许能够捡着漏，搞点破损的神器、仙器或者道器什么的，实在不行，捡着点地图碎片也好，再不济，捡漏点有特殊效果的法器符箓也行。
content_en:
"Well, I understand, don't worry, father, mother, I will definitely reach the fourth level of Qi training before the family test."
Ye Feifan firmly made a guarantee. He had stayed in the Ye family for a year and had heard about the efficacy of the Qi Gathering Pill. It could speed up the speed of Qi gathering in the early and middle stages of Qi training. After all, there were no special difficulties in the early and middle stages of Qi training. The main thing was to store spiritual energy in the body. The more stored, the higher the state. Qi Gathering Pill can speed up the process of absorbing spiritual energy to a certain extent. It can be said that it is a pill that is very suitable for Ye Feifan at this stage.
It is said that there is no best elixir, only suitable elixir. Of course, it would be better if there was a pill that can change your spiritual roots and change your fate. Unfortunately, you can only think about it. As long as your Ye family dares to have that kind of pill, others will dare to wipe you out. After all, in the late stage of foundation building, you are really not good enough in this world, and you belong to the lower class.
"Take it, there are 10 Qi Gathering Pills in this box. Don't run around during this period. Just take this pill honestly." Ye Hu took out a wooden box and handed it to Ye Feifan.
Ye Feifan took the box and after opening it, he saw 10 Qi Gathering Pills neatly placed inside, and an idea emerged in his mind unconsciously.
"This is the Qi Gathering Pill? Why does it look more and more like Malisu? Look at the shape, the color, and the luster. I wonder if sugar was added when refining it. I hope it won't be too bitter."
"Father, what state are my brother and sister in now?" Ye Feifan paused his random thoughts and asked.
"Your eldest brother Ye Feiyang is now at the eleventh level of Qi training, and he is also the son of the family leader. The ancestor values him very much. He is currently being trained as the future family leader, and he has great hope of inheriting the position of the family leader in the future.
Your second brother Ye Xinghuai is currently at the ninth level of Qi training. Although he is not as good as Ye Feiyang, his performance is already very good among the younger generation. He is expected to be able to obtain the position of an elder in the future, provided that he can successfully break through to the foundation building stage.
Your third sister, Ye Ningshuang, is at the eighth level of qi training. Compared with the younger generation, she can only be said to be quite satisfactory. It is still unknown what her plans will be in the future.
As for the other younger generations, there are those at the third level of Qi training to the ninth level of Qi training, and you are at the bottom among them. Although everyone knows that you have been in a coma for many years due to a head injury, after all, as one of the legitimate sons of the Ye family, there is no guarantee that no one will gossip about you at this level. I hope that you, Fei Fei, can maintain a good attitude and not be affected by other people. "
Ye Hu talked about other people's situations one by one, and gave some warnings to Ye Feifan. After all, Ye Feifan was also a young man, and he was deeply afraid that he would be influenced to do irrational things.
But Ye Hu never expected that this Ye Feifan was no longer the former Ye Feifan. The new Ye Feifan was deeply influenced by the online novels in his previous life. Rather than fearing being ridiculed, he was now more looking forward to being ridiculed, so that he could hope to cheat. As for ridicule, come and slap him in the face after cheating. This is about reciprocity.
"Then the main content of this family examination is only to test the cultivation level? Will there be competitions among peers and the like?"
Ye Feifan looked at his father and asked
"The main purpose of the family inspection is to focus on checking the cultivation of peers, so that everyone can understand each other. At the same time, I hope it can put some pressure on the younger generation at the forefront and give some motivation to the younger generation who are lagging behind. As for the martial arts competition, this should be , But you don’t have to worry, because your level is still relatively low, and you haven’t learned any martial arts or techniques. Even if you have, you will definitely not be arranged to compete in martial arts. "Ye Hu was worried that Ye Feifan was afraid of competing because of his low level, so he comforted him.
"Okay, father, I understand, then I will go back to practice first."
After getting the desired information, he put away the box containing the Qi Gathering Pill, and Ye Feifan said goodbye to Ye Hu."Well, then you go ahead. Your mother and I still have to deal with some things in the store, so don't run around. Seeing as you walked around the market every day during the day, you didn't know what you were doing. If you have so much time, you might as well come to me to study, so that you can better take over the position of manager of this store in the future."
"Okay, I understand, then I'm leaving." Ye Feifan answered somewhat perfunctorily and walked out of the room.
Seeing her son leaving, Sun Susu sighed.
"After my son woke up, he felt that he was not as close to us as before."
"You are probably too worried. After all, Fei Fei has been in a coma for several years. Now that he wakes up, he is more or less an adult. He will definitely not be as close to us as before. Besides, I have been secretly observing him for a while. Judging from his cultivation, it doesn't look like he has great power." Ye Hu looked at his wife and said.
Sun Susu also nodded and sighed.
"Fei Fei has missed several years. I hope it won't affect his future life."
…
After Ye Feifan left Ye's shop, he did not go back directly, but continued to wander around the market.
This is also one of his daily routines. When he has free time, he comes to the market to stroll around. Maybe he can pick up some broken artifacts, immortal tools, or Taoist tools. If that doesn't work, he can just pick up some fragments of the map. If that doesn't work, he can also pick up some magic tools and talismans with special effects.
